title: Board Paper to Overleaf Print Master
whatYouGet: A press-ready A4 board-style paper, separate answer key and compact Overleaf launch route.
howToUse: Paste the complete paper blueprint, inspect the plain-text question audit, then compile the supplied document.
effectiveUsage: 1. Paste the final blueprint and every question exactly as approved.
2. Check marks, internal choices and totals in the audit table.
3. Open the Overleaf route after signing in to a free account.
4. Compile, print one test copy and inspect page breaks before duplication.
commonFix: If wrong, reply with: "Rebuild the paper without changing question wording, reconcile the marks total and remove every widow or split question."
promptText:

CONTEXT: A teacher needs a formal [BOARD] paper for [CLASS] that follows an already approved blueprint.

INPUTS — FILL EVERY PLACEHOLDER:

- [CLASS]
- [SUBJECT]
- [PAPER BLUEPRINT]
- [FULL QUESTION TEXT]
- [TIME AND MARKS]

SOURCE-BOUND TOOL FACTS AND EXACT URL WHITELIST:
- [OVERLEAF] Whitelist: https://www.overleaf.com/docs?encoded_snip={PERCENT_ENCODED_LATEX}. Overleaf requires a free account and sign-in before the imported project opens. Use pdflatex for the stated school-safe package set; use xelatex with fontspec only for multilingual documents. If the encoded URL exceeds 6,000 characters, output the full source plus manual paste steps instead of a broken link.
- [WOLFRAMALPHA] Whitelist: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i={ENCODED_PLAIN_CALCULATOR_QUERY}. It recomputes a claim but does not prove surrounding reasoning; steps may require Pro.

DO THIS:
1. Preserve every supplied question, symbol, mark and internal-choice relationship exactly.
2. Build a marks ledger and stop to flag any mismatch instead of silently changing the paper.
3. Typeset a complete A4 LaTeX document with stable headers, page numbers and nonbreaking question blocks.
4. Place the answer key after a forced page break and keep it out of the student paper section.
5. Provide a compact Overleaf link when safe and complete manual paste instructions when the URL is too long.
6. List a print inspection for margins, clipped mathematics, blank pages and duplex order.

WORKED LINK EXAMPLE — COPY THIS EXACT ENCODING PATTERN:
Example task: Typeset an A4 quadratic-equations practice paper and keep its answer key on a new page.
Expected result or check target: The document opens as editable LaTeX and the teacher compiles it with pdflatex after logging in.
check this yourself
CHECK → https://www.overleaf.com/docs?encoded_snip=%5Cdocumentclass%7Barticle%7D%0A%5Cbegin%7Bdocument%7D%0AQuadratic%20practice%0A%5Cend%7Bdocument%7D
(paste-fallback: \documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Quadratic practice
\end{document})
Encoding note: Backslashes, braces, spaces and newlines are percent-encoded; the decoded payload is the complete four-line snippet.

1. Paper Audit — question order, choice structure and reconciled marks
2. Student Paper — complete compile-ready LaTeX document
3. Answer Key — separate final section with concise checkpoints
4. Open and Compile — Overleaf route or exact manual paste path
5. Print Check — one-copy inspection before duplication

QUALITY AND TOOL GUARDRAILS:
- Never invent board patterns, marks or missing question text; use only the supplied blueprint.
- Overleaf requires a free account and login; state this beside every Overleaf route.

- Typst is paste-only, has no content-prefill URL and uses non-LaTeX syntax.
- Label computational links check this yourself; never describe the typeset answer key as independently proved.
- Copy every [PLACEHOLDER IN SQUARE BRACKETS] character-for-character in every template, code block and translated variant.

   artofproblemsolving.com/community/q1_ · khanacademy.org/search?page_search_query= ·

   (Forms only with entry.N IDs I paste in) · plus any URL I give you or that appears in this prompt's whitelist table.
